comments.author: @lostnaustin7390
comments.text: The grave with the hands embracing reminds me of another grave that has the completely opposite gesture.  It is the tomb of  Salvador María del Carril (former vice president/governor figure) and his wife Tiburcia Domínguez, and it is also located in La Recoleta Cemetery.....same cemetery as the first story.  Supposedly they had a bad marriage and towards the end of their lives they were hardly speaking to one another.  Salvador died first with his wife following in latter years and when she died, her request was to have her sculpted bust facing away from her husband's...such as their relationship in life.  Even in death she had the last word.

comments.author: @elina3425
comments.text: Chase Vault, re moving caskets, this is a well known feature of below ground vaults, it's caused by flooding. The vault floods floating the caskets, then as the water drains into the earth the caskets settle wherever they fancy, Also you mention them being lead lined, most unusual. Lead lining is required for above ground vaults only.
